correctness.rationale: With ε=-α>0, rescaling x=√ε X, y=εY, τ=√ε t and δ=ε^(3/2) yields exactly X’=Y, Y’=-X³+δ(Y³-X²Y). At δ=0, Hamiltonian H=Y²/2+X⁴/4 admits smooth ovals. Direct integration of dH/dτ=δ(Y⁴-X²Y²) around an oval gives first displacement F(R)=√2 R⁵(R² I3-2 I1), I1=B(3/4,3/2)/4, I3=B(1/4,5/2)/4, unique positive simple zero ρ²=2I1/I3, F’(ρ)=2√2 ρ⁶ I3. Analytic Poincaré implicit-function theorem yields local cycle and analytic τ-period; exact time reversal for δ↦-δ forces even R,T and odd log Floquet multiplier. Liouville divergence yields J*=2√2 ρ³ I3>0; undoing time scaling yields physical period T*ε^(-1/2)+O(ε^(5/2)), amplitude ρ√ε+O(ε^(7/2)), logμ=J* ε^(3/2)+O(ε^(9/2)). Independently computed ρ≈0.799828239975, T*≈9.272364163377, J*≈1.084199920792 and symbolically verified the simple-root derivative. Zhuang–Liu primary theorem supplies global uniqueness; finite RK4 script is not proof.
